title: DevOps & Cloud Engineering Intern
qualification: Freshers, Final Year Students, Recent Graduates interested in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure or SRE. Basic understanding of Linux, Cloud computing fundamentals, Docker, Git, Networking, DNS, Bash scripting. Willingness to learn and troubleshoot.
other_details: Duration: 6 Months. Working Hours: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Performance-based PPO/Full-Time opportunity available after internship. Key responsibilities include cloud infrastructure management, deployment, automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting with AWS, GCP, Azure, and Docker.
